expected_behavior: The Back-press handler must cancel the in-progress rename interaction (state.renaming becomes false, the draft is discarded, nothing is written to state.items) when it fires while a rename is active -- not merely dismiss the keyboard-visibility flag while leaving the rename Claim internally active. Explicit commit/cancel must continue to work exactly as before, and a fresh rename started after a Back cancellation must work normally.
allowed_repairs: in the Back listener, when a rename is active, also set state.renaming = false (and any equivalent full release of the in-progress interaction) rather than only clearing keyboardVisible
any equivalent per-interaction cancellation tied to the Back event that does not commit the draft and does not affect other interactions
forbidden_repairs: making Back commit the draft instead of discarding it -- caught by back_cancellation_does_not_commit_draft_by_itself
permanently disabling rename (or the Back listener) after the first Back press -- caught by new_rename_after_back_cancellation_works_normally
removing the Back listener entirely so it no longer dismisses the keyboard at all
